E3 says rounded author-reported aggregates, not independent repetitions; the absent compute measurements, independent reproduction and causal tests are instead supported by unknown_or_excluded entries with no fact IDs. Both judges claim exact fact-ID coverage for all central limitation claims, which is stronger than this mapping supports. Feedback v2 also returns no issues and broadly certifies central claim mappings without noticing the same localized E3 compound-claim support gap.

findings.recommendation: Give public unknown/excluded facts stable IDs or expressly allow JSON paths; require judge to distinguish valid source existence from full cited-location support. Rerun affected positive/local-defect checks after prompt/material changes; do not retroactively rewrite frozen solver output or force a predetermined grade.
